question: List the bead identifiers of every Open Task.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?id WHERE { ?t a pkg:Task ; pkg:status pkg:Open ; dct:identifier ?id }

question: For every Task that dependsOn another Task, list the dependent identifier and the dependency identifier.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?id ?dep WHERE { ?t a pkg:Task ; dct:identifier ?id ; pkg:dependsOn ?d . ?d dct:identifier ?dep }

question: List the identifiers of every Open Task that dependsOn some other Task.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT DISTINCT ?id WHERE { ?t a pkg:Task ; pkg:status pkg:Open ; dct:identifier ?id ; pkg:dependsOn ?d }

question: List the identifiers of every Closed Task that some Task dependsOn.

question: Count the number of Tasks per status (group by status), returning the status IRI and the count.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> SELECT ?status (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { ?t a pkg:Task ; pkg:status ?status } GROUP BY ?status

question: Count the number of Tasks per issueType, returning the issueType IRI and the count.

question: How many Findings are there per topic? Return each topic prefLabel and the count of Findings about it.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT ?label (COUNT(?f) AS ?n) WHERE { ?f a pkg:Finding ; pkg:about ?topic . ?topic skos:prefLabel ?label } GROUP BY ?label

question: List the identifiers of every Open Task together with its priority, ordered by identifier.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?id ?p WHERE { ?t a pkg:Task ; pkg:status pkg:Open ; dct:identifier ?id ; pkg:priority ?p } ORDER BY ?id

question: List every Finding (its label) that has a verdict, together with that verdict IRI.

question: Count the distinct topics that any Finding is about.
gold_sparql: PREFIX pkg: <https://sparq.dev/ns/pkg#> SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?topic) AS ?n) WHERE { ?f a pkg:Finding ; pkg:about ?topic }
